title: NDA Life #1 · NDA campus tour: 6 places every cadet knows

captions.instagram:
NDA campus tour: 6 places every cadet knows 🇮🇳

1 Sudan Block, NDA's landmark
2 A squadron building: cadets live in squadrons
3 One of NDA's three swimming pools
4 The riding ring: horse riding is part of training
5 Peacock Bay on Khadakwasla lake: water sports all year
6 Khetarpal Ground: the passing-out parade, where the course crosses the Antim Pag, the last step

At the 149th course's parade (30 Nov 2025), a Su-30 fly-past finished it (PIB).

Which place do you want to see first? Comment its number 👇

It starts with the written exam: maths is 300 of the 900 marks.

Our own model of NDA, not to scale.
